title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face. Start by creating the first loop, which consists of four lines. Draw the first line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.0312, 0.0), then draw the second line from (0.0312, 0.0) to (0.0312, 0.0312), followed by the third line from (0.0312, 0.0312) to (0.0, 0.0312), and finally, draw the fourth line from (0.0, 0.0312) back to the origin. Apply a scaling factor of 0.0312 to the entire two-dimensional sketch to ensure uniform scaling. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions by rotating it using the Euler angles set to zero and translating it using the translation vector set to zero. Extrude the two-dimensional sketch along the normal direction by 0.75 units to generate the three-dimensional model. Ensure that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction, resulting in a new solid body. The final model, named the stylized pen or pencil, has a vertical, cylindrical structure with a pointed tip at the bottom. The length, width, and height of the model are 0.03125 units, 0.03125 units, and 0.75 units, respectively.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0, 0).lineTo(0.0312, 0).lineTo(0.0312, 0.0312).lineTo(0, 0.0312).close()

# Extrude the sketch
extrusion = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# The final model
r = extrusion
